Outline several options to potentially recoup credit card fees. Options 2 and 3 outline the possibility to begin using a service fee for online transactions such as payment of parking tickets, leisure registrations or Gordy how campground reservations.

These options are not being recommended as it would create inconsistent charges for users between online and in person transactions and also disincentivize online transactions, which are more efficient method of registration and payment from an administration perspective.
